latencyDefinition: Last detected input signal through React display commit; harnessElapsedMs includes fixture playback, polling and deliberate idle waits.
scope: Synthetic recorded speech through browser, GPT Live, backend, persistence and React commit; excludes physical microphone and student usability.
intervalMethod: Two-sided 80% Wilson score; per scenario only. Pooled confidence omitted because scenarios share trials.
